definitions.explanation: An organized group of musicians, especially a military band, police band, or marching band. Distinct from rock bands or orchestras.

examples.japanese: {陸上自衛隊|りくじょうじえいたい}{音楽隊|おんがくたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聴|き}いた→聴く：30010_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I listened to a performance by the Ground Self-Defense Force band.

examples.japanese: ⟦パレード→パレード：11293_pareedo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{音楽隊|おんがくたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{先頭|せんとう}→先頭：04374_sentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: The marching band led the parade.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧{音楽隊|おんがくたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧⟦コンサート→コンサート：01360_konsaato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いて→開く：01979_hiraku⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交流|こうりゅう}→交流：02732_kouryuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{深|ふか}めている→深める：02407_fukameru⟧。
examples.english: The police band holds community concerts to deepen ties with local residents.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧ (music) + ⟦{隊|たい}→隊：03383_tai⟧ (corps/squad/group). The suffix ⟦{隊|たい}→隊：03383_tai⟧ gives this word a structured, organizational feel, distinguishing it from casual music groups.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {軍|ぐん}{楽隊|がくたい}/{音楽隊|おんがくたい}: military band
- ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧{音楽隊|おんがくたい}: police band
- ⟦{自衛隊|じえいたい}→自衛隊：05790_jieitai⟧{音楽隊|おんがくたい}: Self-Defense Forces band
- {音楽隊|おんがくたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧: band performance
- {音楽隊|おんがくたい}{員|いん}: band member

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, the ⟦{自衛隊|じえいたい}→自衛隊：05790_jieitai⟧{音楽隊|おんがくたい} (Self-Defense Forces bands) are well known and regularly perform free public concerts. Each branch of the SDF has its own {音楽隊|おんがくたい}. Their concerts are popular community events.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦バンド→バンド：05508_bando⟧: band (loanword) — typically refers to rock/pop bands
- ⟦{楽団|がくだん}→楽団：13181_gakudan⟧: orchestra; musical ensemble — classical or jazz ensembles
- {楽隊|がくたい}: band; musical group — similar meaning but slightly older-fashioned
- ⟦{吹奏楽|すいそうがく}{部|ぶ}→吹奏楽部：27464_suisougakubu⟧: wind ensemble club — school club for wind instruments
